name: "Moo Shu" Shrimp Wraps with Egg, Mushroom, Cabbage & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs in a small bowl and whisk until smooth.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add egg to the pot and scramble using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until no longer runny; add to the plate with the shrimp and re-cover with the foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.
Once the pot is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onion, ginger, and garlic powder; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add mushrooms, cabbage, salt, and pepper to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return shrimp and egg to the pot, then add hoisin sauce; stir to combine. Continue to cook the "moo shu" filling until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas and "moo shu" filling between plates. Serve with additional hoisin sauce on the side for dipping and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
